**Yes, but it breaks the first release invariant, so it only makes sense if almost nobody has the app installed yet.**

macOS ties permissions to the bundle identifier, so on every existing install the rename would:

- drop the Accessibility and Microphone grants, so users must re-grant both;
- reset preferences, which live under the old identifier;
- possibly trigger Keychain prompts.

Users never see the identifier, and the app can be called OpenRamble without changing it.

If the only installs are yours and a few testers, rename now; it only gets more expensive after launch. If there is a real beta base updating through Sparkle, keep `is.waiwai.dictation`.

How many installs exist today?
